title: Tobacco Industry
summary: Tobacco production requires simultaneous control of OPC UA machinery, GSCA event workflows, and TPD track-and-trace obligations. OnSuite TMC provides a vendor-neutral, standards-based data layer for this environment.
detail: Running live in 9 countries with 300 connected machines across 28 OEM brands.
